hooks.command:
K="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/context-db/bin/kit_profile.py"
S="$(python3 "$K" scratch 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -n "$S" ] && [ ! -L "$S/hooks.log" ] && ( : >>"$S/hooks.log" ) 2>/dev/null; then T="$S/hooks.log"; else T=/dev/null; fi
if [ -n "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-}" ]; then
  if out="$(python3 "$K" session-env 2>>"$T")" && ( tmpdir="$(dirname "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE")"; tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.ai-baton-env.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null)" || tmp="$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE.tmp.$$"; { [ -f "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && sed '/^# ai-baton session-env begin$/,/^# ai-baton session-env end$/d' "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; printf '%s\n' '# ai-baton session-env begin' "$out" '# ai-baton session-env end'; } > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ) 2>>"$T"; then
    :
  else
    if [ "$T" = /dev/null ]; then echo "ai-baton: session-env failed writing to $CLAUDE_ENV_FILE - (no log available)"; else echo "ai-baton: session-env failed writing to $CLAUDE_ENV_FILE - see $T"; fi
  fi
fi
python3 "$K" workspace-rules 2>>"$T" || echo "ai-baton: the SessionStart hook could not load WORKSPACE.md (kit_profile.py workspace-rules failed) - the always-on rules are missing from this session; run /kit-health"
exit 0
